results.note: The UKMTO PDF and ukmto.org return 403. The Red Zone (26 Nov) summarises UKMTO 222-26, which the UKMTO X feed lists: a tanker master reported an explosion caused by an unknown projectile close to the ship, 50 NM west of Dubai in the Persian Gulf, at 21:30 UTC on 25 Nov (01:30 GST on 26 Nov), with no damage, and UKMTO classed it as suspicious activity.
